description: This file defines a Java class `Event` used for creating and sending event notifications via UDP datagrams, including timestamp and event type information, with logging and JSON serialization support.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Class representing an event that can be serialized to JSON and sent over the network as a UDP packet with timestamp and event type.

methods.name: Event
methods.description: Constructor initializing event with a specific event type.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Generates and returns the current timestamp as a string.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Serializes the event to JSON and sends it via UDP to localhost on port 8711, with error handling and logging.
